title: Black Casio fx-991EX ClassWiz
description: Left on the last bench in PRP C Block, 3rd floor, after the CAT-II paper. The fx-991EX has a loose slide cover, a nick by SHIFT, and faint pencil initials on the back.

title: Black Casio fx-991EX ClassWiz
description: Found outside TT’s mechanical lab after the afternoon slot. The fx-991EX has a cloudy slide cover, a green star sticker above the solar panel, and a worn MODE key.

title: Black Sony WH-CH520 wireless headphones
description: Found on the back table at Foodys after lunch. The black Sony WH-CH520 on-ear headphones have a small scrape on the left ear cup and a short blue thread caught near the headband.

title: Black Sony WH-CH520 wireless headphones
description: Last seen by the SJT 4th-floor elevator seats before the 10:20 class. The black Sony WH-CH520 headphones have a thin grey scratch on the right ear cup and a loose bit of padding near the headband.

title: Blue Milton Thermosteel 750 ml bottle
description: Left on the Woodys table by the juice counter around 2 PM. It’s a dark blue Milton steel bottle with a dent around the base and a black flip-top lid.

title: Lenovo 65W USB-C laptop charger
description: Picked up from the socket row in SJT 304 after the last lecture. It is a black Lenovo 65W Standard USB-C AC adapter; a short strip of black tape wraps the cable near the connector.

title: Silver Sony wired in-ear earphones
description: Last seen on the bench by the Main Building east entrance around 9 AM. The silver Sony earphones have a blue mark on the right bud and a kink close to the 3.5 mm plug.

title: VIT access card in clear sleeve
description: Found by the Gandhi Block notice board during lunch. The clear sleeve has yellow thread through the corner; the card face is turned away so its details stay private.

title: Navy ID card sleeve with silver clip
landmark: Shelter bench near the campus shuttle
description: Noticed it missing after getting off the campus shuttle at the Bus Stand. It’s a slim navy sleeve with a chipped spring clip; the card inside is not shown.

title: Black Wildcraft Wrap Bifold wallet
landmark: Quiet reading desk by the window
description: Found under a chair at the Central Library window desks. It is a black Wildcraft Wrap Bifold wallet with a red inner lining and worn outer corners; no cards are shown.

title: Higher Engineering Mathematics, 45th edition
description: Left in the Central Library 2nd-floor reading area during evening study. B.S. Grewal’s maroon textbook has a blue tab at the vector calculus section and pencil ticks on a few examples.

title: Basic Electrical and Electronics Engineering, 2nd edition
description: Found on the TT staircase landing between classes. D.P. Kothari and I.J. Nagrath’s blue textbook has a bent lower-right corner and a blue underline in the domestic wiring chapter.

title: The Alchemist paperback by Paulo Coelho
description: Left on the SJT 2nd-floor stairwell bench after class. Orange paperback, page 86 folded down, with a short pencil mark beside the paragraph.

title: H&M olive cotton pullover hoodie
description: Found over a chair outside the PRP A Block lecture hall after the evening class. H&M olive hoodie, size M, with a loose drawstring and a faded spot near the left cuff.

title: Roadster blue checked flannel overshirt
description: Left on the MH Q Block common-room sofa during the match. Roadster blue-and-black flannel, size L, missing one dark button at the cuff.

title: Two brass hostel keys with red cloth tag
description: Picked up from the MGR Main Building stairs beside the notice board. Two brass keys on one split ring with a frayed red cotton tag; no room number attached.

title: Single brass key with green plastic cap
description: Last seen by the LH C Block water dispenser before breakfast. One short brass key, three cuts along the blade, with a small green cap on the round head.

title: Three keys on yellow loop with star charm
description: Found beside the MH B Block study-room door on the way upstairs. The ring has two flat nickel keys, one smaller brass key, and a tiny metal star charm.

title: Classmate black zip pencil pouch
description: Left on the PRP B Block 2nd-floor desk by the corridor window. The Classmate canvas pouch has a small planet patch, a blue ink mark inside, and a stiff zip pull.

title: Classmate red A4 spiral lab notebook
description: Found on the TT 3rd-floor Lab 307 workbench after the batch left. Classmate A4 ruled pages, red cover, bent top spiral, and circuit sketches on the first sheet.

title: Grey American Tourister Urban Groove laptop backpack
description: Found outside TT classroom 402 after the morning slot. The grey Urban Groove has a padded 15.6-inch laptop sleeve, two front pockets, and a side bottle pocket; a blue pencil case is inside.

title: Black Wildcraft laptop backpack
description: Last seen by the PRP D Block cafeteria stairs around 3 PM. The Wildcraft bag has a padded laptop sleeve, red zip pull, and a frayed left shoulder strap.

title: Natural Fabindia canvas tote
description: Forgot it at the Woodys outdoor table while packing up. Fabindia cotton tote with a green block print, reinforced handles, and an A5 sketchbook in the main pocket.

title: Blue Safari Connect crossbody sling bag
description: Found on the Bus Stand seat beside the route board after the shuttle left. The blue Safari Connect has an adjustable strap, two front pockets, and an organizer section with a folded timetable.
